meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷:在临时工作区复现、写出最小修复并交付。上游给 openai/codex 提 fork PR;LazyCodex 缺陷则提交内嵌补丁的 issue,不开 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修 bug、提 bug 修复 PR、或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。它接管整个复现、修复与交付流程。

say.text: 帮我修一个 Codex CLI 的 bug,并向上游提 PR
say.note: 先复现,再向 openai/codex 提 fork PR。

say.text: 这个 LazyCodex 的 bug 验证后提个修复 issue
say.note: 附上 diff 补丁,不开 PR。

say.text: 装了 LazyCodex 后 hooks 行为不对,帮我排查并交付修复
say.note: 在临时克隆中修复并清理。

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a specific LazyCodex or Codex bug in a temp workspace, writes the smallest fix, and delivers it: a fork PR to openai/codex, or a verified-fix issue with the patch on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR).
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, debug and PR a defect, or open a PR for a bug in LazyCodex, omo-codex, or Codex CLI.

say_en.text: Fix a Codex CLI bug and open an upstream PR for it.
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then opens a fork PR.

say_en.text: Verify this LazyCodex bug and file a fix issue.
say_en.note: Embeds the tested patch; no PR is opened.

say_en.text: Hook behavior broke after installing LazyCodex—debug and deliver a fix.
say_en.note: Fixes in a fresh temp clone.
